fields.summary_ko.0: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A) fair value estimate was raised from $799,502.75 to $816,101.25, with bullish analyst target of $942,405 and bearish analyst target of $765,000.
fields.summary_ko.1: UBS's $942,405 target reflects optimistic outlook on management transition and capital allocation, while Keefe Bruyette's $765,000 target and underperform rating expresses concern about transition risks from Warren Buffett to Howard Buffett.
fields.summary_ko.2: Earnings growth rate assumption adjusted from 5.25% to 4.82%, net profit margin from 11.84% to 11.48%, and forward PER changed from 26.07x to 26.22x.
